title: Serverless
content: Start building instantly without having to size and scale your cluster. Sit back while we take care of sizing, scaling, security, reliability, and upgrades.

title: Interactive SQL console
content: The fastest and easiest way to connect, explore and query your ClickHouse databases. Exclusively available to ClickHouse Cloud customers.

title: Secure. Verified compliant
content: ClickHouse Cloud is SOC 2 Type II compliant! Security, availability, processing integrity, and confidentiality processes all independently audited.

title: Transparent pricing
content: Pay only for what you use, with resource reservations and scaling controls. Best price / performance ratio and low administrative overhead.

title: Seamless scaling
content: Incredible scaling both horizontally and vertically. Automatic scaling adjusts to variable workloads so you don’t have to over-provision for peak usage.

title: Broad ecosystem
content: Bring your favorite data connectors, visualization tools, SQL and language clients with you.
